title: delivery_windows
description: The two-stage DLR windows of the channels that wait for a definite delivery event (DS-18, DS-19): after the provider accepted a delivery and no definite event came, the short window makes it unknown_pending and the long window makes it unknown. A row without a provider is the channel's window; a row with a provider adjusts it for that provider. The installation version holds the defaults; a tenant version adjusts them for the tenant. Every adjusted window stays between half and twice the channel's installation default, a short window is at least 15 minutes, a long window at most 14 days and never shorter than the short window (DS-50). Push, Web Push, in-app, messaging and webhook channels have no window (DS-13).
